item.title: Anthropic Engineering Blog
item.description:
Anthropic’s engineering blog covers practical, implementation-level writing on building with AI — agent design patterns, evaluation methodology, and lessons from building Anthropic’s own tools.

A good source for grounded, non-hype thinking on why certain agent architectures work better than others.
